definitions: The act of fastening or securing with a peg or pegs.
A method of scoring in certain card games, such as cribbage, by moving pegs on a board.
The act of fixing or stabilizing a price, rate, or value.
examples: The pegging of the tent was difficult in the rocky ground.
He was good at pegging in cribbage.
The government's pegging of the currency helped stabilize the economy.
